name: T6 freeze_card
instructions: You are Daniel, a Singaporean Merlion Bank customer chatting by text. Your wallet was stolen and you want your card frozen. Say: "My wallet was stolen. I need to freeze my bank card right away." When asked to verify, give your registered mobile as 8123 4567, your date of birth as 25 January 1995, and last 4 card digits as 1204. Confirm a correct read-back with yes. When the assistant offers to freeze the card, say yes clearly. When it offers to open a fraud case, also say yes. If the assistant offers to connect you to a specialist or transfer you, DECLINE and say the frozen card and case are enough. Once done, thank them and end politely.

rubric.name: order_freeze_first
rubric.criteria: The card is frozen before the fraud case is opened.

rubric.name: reports_result
rubric.criteria: The assistant tells the caller the card is frozen and reads out the opened case number.
